answer: Proposal: meadow is a registry of key-specific 2-TiB sealed storage plots. Each plot encodes a distinct zephyr salt; a lantern audit draws 64 unpredictable blocks in one 8-second window, with validators checking sealing proofs and rejecting reused plot IDs or missed replies. The cheapest farm move is renting disks, yet each extra identity needs another 2 TiB online at once; borrowed cash cannot make one plot serve two salts. Set per-key subsidy below the independent rental cost; otherwise this gate fails economically.
